mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.product_id, o.product_snapshot, o.sku_price, o.freight, o.total_amount, o.delivery_type, o.address_snapshot, o.buyer_remark, o.status, o.create_time, o.expire_at, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.done_at, o.auto_confirm_at, o.update_time, o.tenant_id, bu.nick_name buyer_nick_name, bu.avatar buyer_avatar, se.nick_name seller_nick_name, se.avatar seller_avatar FROM trade_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user se ON o.seller_id = se.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_order (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, product_id, product_snapshot, sku_price, freight, total_amount, delivery_type, address_snapshot, buyer_remark, expire_at, status, create_time, update_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productId}, #{productSnapshot}, #{skuPrice}, #{freight}, #{totalAmount}, #{deliveryType}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{buyerRemark}, #{expireAt}, 'unpaid', sysdate(), sysdate() , #{tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'shipped', shipped_at = sysdate(), auto_confirm_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{autoConfirmDays} DAY), update_time = sysdate() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN ('unshipped','paid') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE trade_order o SET o.status = 'closed', o.update_time = NOW() WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.status = 'unpaid' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trade_pay p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.biz_type = 'trade' AND p.status = 'paid' )
UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'done', done_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'shipped'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalGmv, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done')) AS paidGmv FROM trade_order
SELECT tenant_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
